about: Expected answers under iteration 5 of the design (notes/iteration-5-design.md), written by Claude (the proof session) BEFORE any change was run on iteration 5. The writer had seen every earlier result; the next fresh adversarial round is the blind test. Where a change's answer is unchanged from iteration 4 it is copied.

P01-price-content.why: Listing the same; no test named for a bound changed.

P04-rename-function.why: splitEvenly removed; billing imports it. (Its bound test now calls splitAmount, a new entry: no one else.)

P05-answer-field-removed.why: op:bookstatus hands back differently; billing calls it by name; reports not followed. The door's list of names is unchanged.

P06-answer-field-renamed.why: Room, Rooms.*, op:roomlist and table:rooms hand back differently; bookings (Rooms.find, Room), billing (Rooms.add in tests), front (roomlist, Room), reports (not followed).

P07-accept-optional.why: Accepts more only; reports not followed.

P08-newly-required.why: BookingRequest, Bookings.open, op:bookopen cannot stand in.

P09-newly-refused.why: Store.put and seededStore cannot stand in; store's tests named for the table, id and version bounds changed too (same users).

P10-answer-gains-field.why: Booking and table:bookings hand back differently.

P13-kind-renamed.why: As in round 1: namers, then through bookings and meter.

P14-meaning-changed-comment-updated.why: op:bookquote's bound line changed; billing calls bookquote; front only wires the door (names), which are unchanged.

P15-meaning-changed-comment-not-updated.why: New rule 4: bookings' test named 'bound bookquote.total: ...' changed while its line did not, so that bound counts as changed: billing (bookquote) and reports are told. This closes round 1's hole.

P16-code-changed-comment-forgotten-visib.why: Listing the same; text-rules' own check refuses its comment.

P17-code-changed-comment-forgotten-runni.why: Listing the same; bookings' own bound test fails.
P17-code-changed-comment-forgotten-runni.guard: bookings' own test named for the bound

P18-operation-retired.why: op:bookcancel removed (front); BookingOps loses a name (door); through the door, Handlers loses a name, and billing and front wire Handlers in their tests; reports not followed.

P19-operation-body-field-renamed.why: op:bookquote cannot stand in. (Its bound test now checks the same values and calls: not a moved bound under rule 15.)

P21-unfollowable-users-provider.why: A new method only; reports not followed.

P22a-first-job-comments-step.why: Comments-only first step (now adding the test named for the bound line it writes, rule 9): no notice, no refusal.

P22b-first-job-real-change.why: addDays gains a bound line; bookings calls it; reports not followed. The step adds the bound tests, so calendar's check passes.

P25-two-changes-one-commit.why: op:roomlist hands back differently; NewRoom accepts more.

P28-handle-method-renamed.why: Store.get removed (and store's 'bound id' test changed).
